description: The same declarations offered as catalogue entries (ADR-0006, tool-offer.json#/$defs/catalogueEntry), as a run whose offeredSchemas is 0 offers them: every source is made a catalogue. The run is then offered load_tool beside them (tool-offer/load-tool.json). Written by hand; toolSources.test.ts holds offerSources to each.
